title: Thacker Pass Bureau of Land Management Record of Decision — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. BLM's January 2021 decision authorizes the selected federal-land alternative for the Thacker Pass lithium mine and processing project while leaving state permits, construction, compliance, commissioning, and output to later records.
key_findings: The decision completes a named federal land-use review for the project.
The federal authorization sits upstream of state environmental conditions, water records, construction, and production.
The record creates a stable starting point for a project-specific authorization-to-output trail.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. Thacker Pass provides a mature example of why an approved critical-minerals project must be followed through several separate delivery stages.
ftfn_relevance: Anchors the Nevada federal authorization layer.
Connects minerals strategy to named land, permit, finance, construction, and output records.
Supports stage-by-stage comparison with Rhyolite Ridge.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Federal land authorization is not state-permit compliance.
The record does not prove construction, commissioning, production, quality, or sales.
Operating and environmental outcomes require later monitoring and enforcement records.
